rationale: itnet_v3-claude-agentic: itnet_k=2, unet_c=24, alpha_init=0.0025734, lr=0.00021567, epochs=5, batch_size=2, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1100, seed=45, rationale=iter-18 (breast-ct redo, search-20260703-01). FOURTH bs=2 seed replicate of the c24/ep5/bs2/lr2.16e-4 champion config. ONE KNOB: seed 44 -> 45. All else = iter-7/16/17 config exactly. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) bs=2 spread so far: s42 0.8469, s43 0.6699, s44 0.8277 -> provisional mean 0.7815 +/- 0.078. Still high-variance (s43 unlucky). bs=1 for comparison: s42 0.8638, s43 0.7983, s44 0.6142 -> 0.759 +/- 0.104. FINDING holds: itnet_v3 breast is intrinsically high-variance (train loss always 1e-6, val hr swings ~0.2); bs=2 is marginally tighter than bs=1. (2) FAILURE MODE: high generalization variance; more seeds needed to tighten the reportable mean. (3) ONE KNOB: seed 44 -> 45 (4th bs=2 point). (4) HYPOTHESIS: n/a (variance replicate); seed 45 refines the 4-point bs=2 mean+/-std. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20min=1200s): bs=2 = 939.5-1096.9s across prior runs, all < 1200s. max_train_s=1100 fences the TRAIN phase. train_n=2400 (<= OOM-safe cap). val=200 distinct val_truth.h5 cases, 256px inscribed-circle FOV (breast default). (6) do NOT return control mid-campaign; gate on iter-18 numeric-headroom obs via iter_wait.sh v3 then dispatch iter-19.
